title: List three fruits on one line with no commas
rationale: Comma-free single-line lists feed tag fields and keyword columns; an inserted comma splits one value into several and corrupts the record that downstream tools ingest.

prompt.content: You are a terse assistant. Output only the requested list: no explanation and no punctuation other than the spaces between words.
Reply with exactly three fruit names on a single line, separated by single spaces, in this order: kiwi mango papaya. Do not use commas anywhere and do not add any other text.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, exact order and single-space separator. Brittleness: a trailing period or a comma after the last fruit fails the anchored line pattern even when the fruit names are correct.
